title: 가트너가 제시한 피지컬 AI에 대한 ‘10가지 오해’
summary: Gartner Japan argues that companies are underestimating physical AI by treating it as just robots plus AI, when it will require redesigning enterprise systems, workflows, and investment plans. Its “10 misconceptions” briefing is aimed at CIOs and executives, warning that firms that delay concrete planning could lose competitiveness after 2030.

summary: Florigen Robotics and ID Quantique have integrated IDQ’s quantum random number generator into Florigen’s FLOW patrol-robot control system, using quantum-random encryption keys to protect data exchanged between mobile surveillance robots and the control center.
